name: Prospective Stable Instrument Identity Bridge
principles: prospective source symbols may map to a stable instrument only through time-bounded bridge evidence
current universe symbol to ISIN mappings are prospective evidence only from the bridge snapshot valid_from
bridge evidence never repairs or relabels earlier scanner observations
stable instrument IDs use validated ISINs for non-crypto securities
source symbol matching is exact case-normalized matching only
punctuation substitution fuzzy matching and name similarity are forbidden
one alias mapping to multiple stable instruments is ambiguous and fails closed
source listing snapshot validity and bridge validity are combined using the later valid_from
venue information may constrain a future matcher but missing venue mapping does not create a match
listing presence does not imply tradability or project investability
unmatched and ambiguous source rows remain explicit
no productive scanner semantics are changed
